hooks.command: echo 'OUTPUT-FORMAT DEFAULT — Ask which format ONLY the first time, i.e. when (a) this turn requests a client-facing deliverable (deck, document, presentation, one-pager, report, slides, briefing) AND (b) no output format has been established yet in this session. In that one case, ASK FIRST: which format would you prefer — HTML deck, long-form HTML, PDF, or PPT? — and wait for the choice. If a format is already being worked on, was chosen earlier in the session, or is named this turn, do NOT ask — just proceed in that format.'
